+	local USAGE=0
+
+	PROVIDER="github"
+	DRY_RUN=0
+
+	while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
+		case "$1" in
+		--help | -h)
+			USAGE=1
+			;;
+
+		--branch=*)
+			BRANCH="${1#*=}"
+			;;
+
+		-b)
+			shift
+			BRANCH="$1"
+			;;
+
+		--provider=*)
+			PROVIDER="${1#*=}"
+			;;
+
+		-p)
+			shift
+			PROVIDER="$1"
+			;;
+
+		--dry-run | -d)
+			DRY_RUN=1
+			;;
+
+		*)
+			if [ -z $REPO ]; then
+				USER=$(echo $1 | cut -d/ -f1)
+				REPO=$(echo $1 | cut -d/ -f2)
+				FILE=$(echo $1 | cut -d/ -f3-)
+			else
+				echo "to many arguments: $1"
+				USAGE=1
+			fi
+			;;
+
+		esac
+		shift
+	done
+
+	if [ -z $BRANCH ]; then
+		case "$PROVIDER" in
+		chisel)
+			BRANCH="trunk"
+			;;
+
+		*)
+			BRANCH="master"
+			;;
+
+		esac
+	fi

+		usage
+		exit
+	fi
